outcome: Give university cio / academic program director a governed method to improve late or missed pickups per route using pickup roster, vehicle GPS and guardian confirmations, with final decisions…
overview: School Bus Routing and Child Accountability addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in education and research operations. The first proof of value uses pickup roster, vehicle GPS and guardian confirmations. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is late or missed pickups per route, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: late or missed pickups per route

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: pickup roster, vehicle GPS and guardian confirmations; define late or missed pickups per route and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from University CIO / Academic Program Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
